claim: Pretreatment inflammation can moderate response to specific antidepressant strategies
main_support: GENDEP CRP-drug interaction; CO-MED biomarker moderators; infliximab CRP interaction
main_challenge: Effects vary by cohort treatment sex and marker; mostly secondary biomarker analyses
required_next_action: Independent prospectively prespecified biomarker-treatment interaction replication

claim: Established TRD populations show higher peripheral inflammatory burden than some comparison groups
main_support: Chamberlain 2019 CRP; several TRD inflammatory studies and reviews
main_challenge: Cross-sectional design; BMI vegetative symptoms anxiety trauma metabolic and treatment exposure confounding
required_next_action: Prospective pre-resistance measurement with repeated biomarkers and confounder control

claim: Elevated CRP prospectively identifies a biologically distinct TRD disease
main_challenge: No validated first-episode pretreatment multi-trial TRD classifier; specificity and stability unmet
required_next_action: Treatment-naive first-episode prospective cohort through at least two adequate failures plus external validation

claim: Inflammation is a candidate endotype cutting across current MDD/TRD boundaries
main_support: Treatment interaction signals; early untreated MDD cytokine alterations; immune-targeting proof-of-concept trials
main_challenge: No universally stable biomarker threshold or validated endotype assignment
required_next_action: Predefine endotype and test stability replication and treatment interaction across independent cohorts

claim: The Hummad 2026 pooled OR 2.11 is independent confirmatory evidence of inflammation-related antidepressant resistance
main_support: Published pooled OR 2.11 with reported low heterogeneity
main_challenge: Multiple GENDEP publications counted separately; mixed study questions; threshold heterogeneity; confounding; unregistered protocol
required_next_action: Reconstruct source-level study-family-deduplicated meta-analysis and verify effect estimates

claim: Inflammation causes treatment resistance in MDD
main_support: Biological plausibility; longitudinal associations; immune-targeting trials
main_challenge: Cross-sectional enrichment and treatment prediction do not establish causality; bidirectionality and confounding remain
required_next_action: Prospective causal design and biomarker-stratified treatment interaction with mediation/temporal evidence

claim: TRD is best represented as one separate inflammatory disease
main_support: Some TRD cohorts show elevated inflammatory markers
main_challenge: Heterogeneous TRD definitions and biology; noninflamed TRD exists; inflammation present in non-TRD MDD; mixed treatment-response findings
required_next_action: Do not use as ontology conclusion unless new decisive evidence emerges

claim: A mixed model of endotype stage severity operational definition and selection best fits this inflammation branch
main_support: Combined evidence from temporality replication confounding and treatment interactions
main_challenge: Pilot not exhaustive and limited to one biological domain
required_next_action: Test other domains independently using same discriminator framework before global MDD/TRD conclusion

claim: Inflammatory biomarkers are ready for routine clinical antidepressant selection
main_support: Promising CRP and cytokine treatment-moderation signals
main_challenge: No prospective biomarker-guided strategy has established decision utility; 2026 meta-analysis itself states routine use unsupported
required_next_action: Prospective biomarker-guided randomized strategy trial with clinical utility outcomes

claim: Regulatory or later-line treatment recognition proves distinct TRD ontology
main_support: TRD is a recognized treatment population
main_challenge: Treatment indication does not establish separate disease ontology
required_next_action: Require diagnostic/pathological evidence independent of regulatory treatment population
